Razorpay raises $375 million in Series F round led by existing investors

By Asha Rao, Sep 21, 2026, 10:15 AM IST

Bengaluru-based payments company Razorpay said on Monday it has raised $375 million in a Series F funding round led by its existing investors, valuing the company at $7.5 billion.

The company plans to use the fresh capital to expand its lending and neo-banking products and to grow its business in South-east Asia, chief executive Harshil Mathur told reporters at a press conference in Bengaluru.

Razorpay processes payments for more than 10 million businesses and competes with PhonePe, Paytm and Cashfree Payments in the Indian market, where digital payments have grown rapidly since 2020.

"We will continue to invest heavily in our core payments business while building new products for small businesses," Mathur said in a statement, adding that the company is not planning an IPO this year.

The round comes weeks after the company cut its standard payment gateway fee for new merchants, a move analysts said was aimed at winning small online sellers from rivals.
